description: Department of Forest Conservation - The Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) Regulations No. 03 of 2021 and shall come into Operation on 15.11.2021
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Forest Conservation Ordinance, establishing legal frameworks for conservation forest management, scientific research permits, and fee structures. It falls under Legal/Regulatory as it creates subsidiary legislation and regulatory requirements rather than dealing with government personnel/structure (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories.
